replies.description: Array of suggested reply options with varying tones and lengths

length.description: short=1-2 sentences, medium=1 paragraph, long=2+ paragraphs

body.description: The actual reply text. Do NOT include subject line, greeting/sign-off can be minimal or omitted for short replies.

label.description: A 2-4 word label describing this reply option (e.g., "Quick Confirm", "Detailed Response", "Polite Decline")
